bratislava-castle.name: Bratislava Castle
bratislava-castle.price_text: ≈ €10 for the museum; castle grounds free
bratislava-castle.hours: Grounds always open · museum roughly 10:00–18:00, check on the day
bratislava-castle.tip: Walk up from the Old Town in about 15 minutes. Go late afternoon for views over the Danube and Austria.

st-martins-cathedral.name: St. Martin's Cathedral
st-martins-cathedral.hours: Open daily but closed during services; check on the day
st-martins-cathedral.tip: Look up at the golden crown on the tower. It marks where Hungarian kings were crowned.

michaels-gate.name: Michael's Gate
michaels-gate.tip: This is the last surviving medieval city gate. Walk under it into the Old Town and look back for the photo.

devin-castle.name: Devín Castle
devin-castle.tip: Ruins on a cliff above where the Morava meets the Danube. Take bus 29 from the Old Town.

bryndzove-halusky.name: Bryndzové Halušky
bryndzove-halusky.price_text: ≈ €8–14 per plate in a traditional pub
bryndzove-halusky.hours: Most pubs serve it at lunch and dinner
bryndzove-halusky.tip: Potato dumplings with sheep cheese and bacon. Order it in a Slovak pub, not a tourist cafe.

morava-river.name: Morava River
morava-river.tip: The river forms the border with Austria. The path by Devín Castle gives the best view of the meeting of rivers.

old-town-hall.name: Old Town Hall, Bratislava
old-town-hall.price_text: ≈ €5 museum entry; check on the day
old-town-hall.tip: Climb the small tower for a close view over the main square. The courtyard is free to enter.

blue-church.name: St. Elisabeth's Church (Blue Church)
blue-church.hours: Short visiting hours, mainly mornings; check on the day
blue-church.tip: A pastel blue church that looks like a fairytale. Go early, it closes to visitors quickly.

ufo-tower.name: UFO Tower
ufo-tower.price_text: ≈ €8 observation deck; check on the day
ufo-tower.tip: Ride the lift up the bridge pylon for a 360° view. Sunset is the best slot.

old-town-walk.name: Old Town walking loop
old-town-walk.tip: Walk from Michael's Gate through the main square to the Danube. Small streets hide courtyards and statues.

mileticova-market.name: Miletičova Market
mileticova-market.price_text: Free to enter; pay for what you buy
mileticova-market.hours: Mainly mornings, busiest Saturday; check on the day
mileticova-market.tip: A local produce market with cheese, fruit and street food. Go early for the best stalls.

danube-promenade.name: Danube promenade and SNP Bridge
danube-promenade.tip: Walk the riverside path under the UFO bridge. Good for an evening stroll with castle views.

slavin.name: Slavín War Memorial
slavin.tip: A hilltop memorial with a wide view over the city. A calm walk up through a park.

petrzalka-walk.name: Petržalka panel-housing walk
petrzalka-walk.tip: Cross the bridge to see the huge socialist-era housing blocks. Interesting for architecture fans.

danube-cruise.name: Danube river cruise
danube-cruise.price_text: ≈ €12–20 for a short city cruise; check on the day
danube-cruise.hours: Departures through the day in season
danube-cruise.tip: A short boat ride gives views of the castle and bridges. Check the weather before booking.

food-tour.name: Slovak food and beer tasting
food-tour.price_text: ≈ €35–55 guided tasting; check on the day
food-tour.tip: Try bryndzové halušky, lokše and local beer in one walk. Book ahead in summer.

nightlife-old-town.name: Old Town bars and nightlife
nightlife-old-town.price_text: Free to walk; pay per drink
nightlife-old-town.tip: The streets around Michalská and Ventúrska fill up at night. Expect a lively, cheap night out.
